title: Calculate Simple Interest
question: Read principal, annual rate, and time in years; calculate simple interest.
code:
principal = float(input("Principal: "))
rate = float(input("Annual rate (%): "))
years = float(input("Years: "))
interest = principal * rate * years / 100
print(f"Simple interest: {interest:g}")
expected_output:
For inputs 1000, 5, and 2:
Principal: 1000
Annual rate (%): 5
Years: 2
Simple interest: 100
explanation: Simple interest is principal multiplied by annual rate and time, divided by 100.
